To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we have shown that spraying of vascular smooth muscle cells and respiratory epithelial cell can be used for tissue engineering and that this technique can be used to coat tissue engineered constructs with cells.
we could show that spraying of cells in a medical spray device is a suitable method for the coating of tissue engineered constructs.

spraying of respiratory epithelial cells and vascular smooth muscle cells was shown to be suitable for tissue engineering, and especially for respiratory epithelial cells this application is of great significance.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the application of a medical spray device for the spraying of respiratory epithelial cells and vascular smooth muscle cells in fibrin gel.
the development of a novel approach to apply cells in a spray for the coating of tissue-engineered constructs.
the application of cells in a spray and its influences on cell viability and differentiation capacity.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the spray method is suitable for cell seeding of tissue engineering constructs.
the spray application of cells in a medical spray device is a suitable technique for the coating of tissue-engineered constructs with vSMCs and epithelial cells.
spray processing of cells is an appropriate method to coat tissue-engineered constructs.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
spraying is a suitable method for coating tissue-engineered constructs with cells.
spray application with air pressure up to 0.8 bars does not influence cell viability, morphology, and differentiation capacity in short- and long-term studies for vSMCs.
spray application of cells with and without fibrins gel is a suitable method to coat tissue engineered constructs with cells.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the spray method is a promising approach to coat tissue-engineered constructs.
spray processing is an efficient and easy method for coating tissue-engineered constructs.
the spray method is suitable for cell application on tissue engineering constructs and may help to improve the coating of luminal surfaces.
